commands.description: Verify the append-only AI audit hash chain and report the first tamper (checksum / gap / prev-link)
commands.help: Suggested: run in a cron or a post-incident gate. `node ace tenant:ai:audit:verify --json || alert`

flags.name: tenant
flags.description: Verify a single tenant (uuid); omit to verify every tenant

commands.description: Erase a tenant, principal, or document AI data (memory + response cache + embeddings) for GDPR
commands.help: Scopes: --tenant <uuid> --force (all); --tenant <uuid> --principal <id> (one user); --tenant <uuid> --source <key> (one document). --dry-run previews and writes nothing.

flags.name: principal
flags.description: Purge only this principal (per-user GDPR erasure: memory + their embeddings)

flags.name: source
flags.description: Purge only this document source key

flags.name: dryRun
flags.description: Preview the counts and write nothing (no delete, no epoch bump)

flags.name: force
flags.description: Required for a full-tenant purge (skips the confirmation)

flags.name: verifyChain
flags.description: Also re-walk the full AI audit chain and record the result (O(n))

flags.name: actor
flags.description: Operator identity recorded in the audit row (defaults to the OS user)
